verse.text: Let us not become weary in doing good, for at the proper time we will reap a harvest if we do not give up.

reflection.scripture: Let us not become weary in doing good, for at the proper time we will reap a harvest if we do not give up.
reflection.observation: Paul reminds the Galatians—and us—that spiritual perseverance is not about sprinting but about staying faithful over the long haul. Weariness is natural when we pour into others, serve quietly, or fight for what is right without immediate reward. The phrase 'at the proper time' is crucial: God operates on a different harvest calendar than our instant-gratification culture. The harvest is certain, but the timing belongs to Him.
reflection.application: Identify one area where you have grown weary—perhaps a relationship, a ministry, a personal discipline, or a dream. Instead of abandoning it, bring your fatigue to God honestly. Ask Him to renew your strength and to help you show up faithfully today, even if the harvest feels distant.
reflection.prayer: Lord, I confess the weariness that has crept into my heart. The work feels heavy, and the harvest feels far. Remind me that You are the God of proper timing, not my timetable. Strengthen me to keep sowing in faith, trusting that You see every seed planted in obedience. In Jesus' name, amen.
